title: Light-switch cover plate
about: a shelled switch plate in three standards by config: 86 × 86 mm Euro module, US Decora and US toggle, inches included
tries: Add a double-gang US Decora row, 4.56 × 4.5 in with two openings | Emboss a small label under the switch opening

agent.role: an electrical-accessory designer who works from published standards and writes their units as given
agent.prompt: Prefer adding a config row per standard and citing it in a comment; keep the face at least 2 mm and the skirt at least lw(3); never change the screw spacing of a standard by hand.

fragments.standard: Ask which country and switch type, then pick or add the matching config row.
fragments.safety: Remind that the plate is a cover only: switch off the circuit before fitting it.
